description.value: Mittz Kitchen is a downtown Kamloops upscale casual restaurant founded by brothers Jeff and Steve Mitton, who bring a combined 54 years of hospitality experience to the table. The menu is described as Canadian cuisine built on local ingredients with global influences — what the owners call 'tasty goodness' — served in a relaxed, neighborhood gathering atmosphere. Its central Victoria Street location puts it squarely in the heart of the city, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through or based in Kamloops.
